messages:
Maria (partnerships): pinging everyone — CloudSwap just pushed a soft-reserve window change on batch CS-7421. they want to shift our hold from the 21st to the 7th of next month. any immediate blockers?
Ken (logistics): that's a ~2 week slip for our EU Dedicated rack commits. we still have the customer SLA for Q4 onboarding.
Leila (sales): which customers are on the line for that commit? I have two SIs waiting to schedule install windows.
Ken (logistics): ACME and BlueLeaf are the big ones. ACME's launch can't move much. BlueLeaf can flex by ~10 days.
Alex (CloudSwap): hey team — sorry about the shuffle. carrier had to rebook containers due to a manifest mismatch. we can offer a partial split: ship 60% on original date, remainder on new window. we can also provide a one-time credit for expedited setup if you need it.
Jason (infra): partial split is workable if we can get contiguous serial ranges for the first shipment — we need matching firmware batches for the SI automation. can CloudSwap tag units by firmware rev?
Alex (CloudSwap): yes, we can tag with inventory tag SWAP-TEST-1 and include CSV with serial, fw_rev, PO. example row: CS-7421-RT, SN12345, v1.4.2
Maria (partnerships): good. can we have a guaranteed fallback policy if customs or ETA slips cause the second tranche to miss the committed install? e.g., route to alternate EU depot or allow Redwood to source an overlap from marketplace pool?
Alex (CloudSwap): we can route to secondary depot but that adds ~48h. overlap sourcing is possible but depends on availability in that week — we can pre-book a conditional soft-reserve for a buffer SKU, no charges unless used.
Ken (logistics): conditional soft-reserve is good. we need hard dates for the canary install window though. Suggest: keep canary on original date with 1 rack (12 units), ship as priority. rest split 60/40 across the two windows.
Leila (sales): note for customer comms: I'll pitch the partial ship + credit as a mitigant. need wording: "staged delivery with priority canary" and assurance on firmware consistency.
Jason (infra): also remind SI to use this command for automated inventory import: 
```
redwood-inventory import --csv swapped.csv --tag SWAP-TEST-1 --po CS-7421-RT
```
Ken (logistics): Alex — can you confirm ETA for the priority canary and provide container IDs? need to lock trucking and customs docs.
Alex (CloudSwap): container IDs: CXS-9081 (canary) ETA 2564128200. bulk containers: CXS-9082 / CXS-9083 ETA 2564129500. will push docs to the portal in 30m.
shipment-bot: Document upload: CS-7421 / bill_of_lading.pdf (uploaded by Alex). :page_facing_up:
Maria (partnerships): action items summary: 1) CloudSwap to provide tagged CSV + firmware map (Alex) 2) Ken to book trucking for CXS-9081 and provisional trucking for bulk (Ken) 3) Jason to coordinate SI firmware check and import test (Jason) 4) Leila to prep customer comms with staged-delivery language (Leila) — target: internal draft in 2 business hours.
Ken (logistics): i started the provisional trucking quote now. if we get the CSV early we can pre-fill customs manifest.
Alex (CloudSwap): CSV and fw map sent to portal and DM. I also created soft-reserve token SR-CLD-002 as the conditional buffer.
Maria (partnerships): thanks. one more: can CloudSwap include unit-level serials for visibility in Redwood Console so ops can tag cost and latency to the canary rack?
Alex (CloudSwap): yes — we'll push serials to the console integration endpoint. sharing webhook URL with Maria now.
Jason (infra): once serials are in, we'll run a quick whitebox test: 2 inference traces + KV cache priming. expecting <25ms median for canary profile.
Leila (sales): i'll add the credit line in the customer note: "CloudSwap will provide a one-time expedite credit and Redwood will perform a priority canary install."
Ken (logistics): FYI customs hold risk still exists due to declaration mismatch. Alex, can you confirm HS codes on the BOL?
Alex (CloudSwap): confirmed HS code 8471.80 for all SKUs, same on all docs. i updated the BOL to reflect that.
Maria (partnerships): ok team — if we all ack, i'll finalize the partner playbook update and post a short runbook in #eng-logistics and #support. please react with :thumbsup: once you've completed your item.
Ken (logistics): :thumbsup: will update when trucking is locked (t+45m).
Jason (infra): :thumbsup: will run import test after CSV arrives.
Leila (sales): :thumbsup: drafting now.
Alex (CloudSwap): :thumbsup: monitoring for any more snags.
Maria (partnerships): closing the loop here — thanks everyone, i'll send the consolidated timeline and press-hold wording for joint announcement to Alex and Leila.
